verdict.rationale: The evidence shows privacy controls over the error data an application sends to Raygun: filtering sensitive fields before sending, and a 'Disable IP address storage' flag. These are adjacent data-handling controls, not a documented way for the user to opt out of Raygun's own telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack describes such an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
